traits.note: Jepson eFlora's account of velvet mesquite, as search results quote it (the page itself was not read): flower radial, small; calyx shallowly bell-shaped; petals free, generally inconspicuous; stamens 10, exserted, free.

traits.flowering_position.note: The Woody Plant Seed Manual's Prosopis chapter (read in full; the American mesquites were in Prosopis then): the flowers are borne in spike-like axillary racemes.
